Subscriptions, Trials, Cancellation & Refunds

Effective July 7, 2026 · Version 2.1

On iOS, Apple handles all of this — not Remvoll. > > Subscriptions are sold through the App Store and billed to your Apple Account. Remvoll never sees, handles, or stores your payment details, and cannot charge, refund, or cancel anything on your behalf. > > - To see or cancel a subscription: Settings › your name › Subscriptions, or the App Store app › your account › Subscriptions. > - To cancel before a free trial ends: cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, or it renews at the stated price. > - Renewal: subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. The price and period are shown on the purchase screen before you buy and again by Apple at confirmation. > - To request a refund: use Apple\'s process at reportaproblem.apple.com. Refund decisions are Apple\'s to make, under the terms of the Apple Media Services agreement. > > The sections below describe Remvoll\'s own policies where they apply; where they conflict with Apple\'s rules for App Store purchases, Apple\'s rules govern.
How buying works here. There is no checkout inside Remvoll. Tapping a plan hands you to Apple's own purchase sheet, and Apple bills your Apple Account. Remvoll never collects a card number and cannot charge you.

1. The free trial, plainly

  • Every new account starts a one-time 30-day free trial with full access to every feature, including the complete sound library, Breath Entrainment, analytics, and adaptation.
  • You are charged $0 today and $0 during the trial. If you do not subscribe before day 30, overnight playback simply pauses — you are never silently converted to a paid plan and never charged for the trial.
  • Trials are limited to one per person or device. We may withhold or revoke trials we reasonably determine are being abused (for example, repeated sign-ups to obtain serial trials).

2. Plans and pricing

  • Plan — Monthly — Yearly — Adds
  • Sleep Core — $2.99 — $24.99 — Full engine & library, Breath Entrainment, presets, offline playback
  • Sleep Intelligence — $4.99 — $29.99 — Rest analytics, night & disturbance summaries, historical trends, jet-lag recovery mode
  • Sleep Adaptive — $7.99 — $59.99 — Adaptive Listening (opt-in mic), multi-night adaptation, advanced variation controls

Yearly plans are offered with the same one-month free trial as monthly plans, once per plan, per Apple Account. Overnight playback is never rate-limited or capped on any paid plan. The prices displayed in the application at the moment of purchase always govern that purchase, and may differ by region, currency, taxes, and app-store rules.

3. How and when you are billed

  • Subscriptions are sold on a recurring basis and, unless cancelled, renew automatically at the then-current price at the end of each billing period (monthly or yearly, as selected).
  • Your first charge occurs only after any free trial ends, and only if you have not cancelled by then.
  • Every purchase is billed by Apple to your Apple Account and is subject to Apple's own billing, renewal and cancellation mechanics.
  • Applicable taxes may be added by Apple at purchase.

4. Cancellation

  • You can cancel at any time, during a trial or a paid period, in Settings › your name › Subscriptions on your iPhone. You › Manage subscription in the app opens the same Apple sheet.
  • Canceling during the trial means you are never billed. You keep full access until the trial's scheduled end.
  • Canceling a paid subscription stops all future renewals. You retain access to the paid features until the end of the period you have already paid for; access is not cut off mid-period.
  • To avoid the next charge, cancel at least 24 hours before the current period renews (store policies may specify their own cut-off).

5. Refunds

  • Apple handles every refund. All subscriptions are bought through the App Store, so refunds are decided by Apple under Apple's policy and must be requested at reportaproblem.apple.com. Remvoll cannot issue, approve or deny a refund for an App Store purchase, and cannot see the outcome of your request.
  • Statutory rights. If you are a consumer in the EU/EEA, UK, or another jurisdiction with mandatory withdrawal or refund rights, those rights apply and are honored. Note that where you expressly request immediate access to digital content and acknowledge the loss of the withdrawal right, statutory withdrawal may not apply — but our voluntary 14-day direct-purchase refund window above still does.
  • Billing errors. Duplicate charges, charges after a valid cancellation, or amounts that do not match the price shown at purchase are refunded in full, promptly, upon verification.

6. Price changes

We may change subscription prices prospectively. Existing subscribers will receive at least 30 days' advance in-app notice, and any new price applies only from the next renewal following the notice period. You may cancel before the change takes effect; continuing your subscription after that date constitutes acceptance of the new price.

7. Failed payments, lapses, and reactivation

If a renewal payment fails, Apple may retry for a limited period and will notify you. If payment cannot be collected, access simply pauses; no debt accrues to us, because we never bill you. Your locally-stored data — presets, preferences, and history — remains on your device regardless of membership state, and access is restored when you resubscribe.

8. Promotional offers

We may from time to time offer discounts, extended trials, or promotional pricing subject to additional terms disclosed at the time of the offer. Promotions are limited, non-transferable, have no cash value, and may be modified or withdrawn except where doing so is prohibited by law.

9. Taxes

Prices in the app are shown exactly as Apple reports them for your storefront, in your currency, inclusive or exclusive of tax according to local rules. Apple collects and remits tax where required.

Billing questions: support@remvoll.app (placeholder until public launch).

Remvoll runs entirely on your device. Questions: legal@remvoll.app
